Coverage: Possible to reset state by toggling rst
All signals shall react to the risign edge of the input clk signal
in_valid and in_data always propagated to output on next rising edge of clk
The saturation functionality of the design shall be evaluated with the THRESHOLD parameter value. If in_data is above the THRESHOLD
Verification Criteria: the data is saturated and the out_data signal will be equal to the THRESHOLD. Otherwise the out_data will be equal to in_data.

Coverage: if the data is saturated the overflow signal shall be high
The Saturation Filter shall be compliant with the sSDT (simple SyoSil Data Transfer) protocol
